title: Red Fish Blue Mountain
meta_description: Red Fish Blue Mountain: 4BR, private beach, heated pool, playground, fitness room, golf cart charging, and serene 30A coastal charm at Blue Mountain.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Welcome to "Red Fish Blue Mountain", a 4 bedroom, 3 bath condo with a large outside patio and private lanai! Conveniently located a block away from a private Blue Mountain Beach access, which is only accessible to owners and guests of Red Fish Village Condominiums. This property is located in Red Fish Village, on 30A. The complex borders the beautiful Redfish Lake and provides a boardwalk and overlook pavilion to explore the surrounding nature and soak in all of the scenery

ABOUT THE AREA: Blue Mountain Beach is one of the 30A coastal communities that rests between Santa Rosa Beach and Grayton Beach State Park, balconies as well to sit with your morning coffee and watch the sunrise, or sunset. The Blue Mountain community is known for its tranquility, many restaurants, and family atmosphere. The natural beauty of the sugar sand beaches, walking, biking trails and adventure await you.

BEACH ACCESS: Private beach across street, about 3 blocks walk (has restrooms, \& shower) just east of Blue Mountain Regional public beach. There is some parking and chairs, coolers, wagons and single inflatable toys are permitted, as well as kayaks and paddle boards.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 --1 King, ensuite
• Bedroom 2 --King ensuite
• Bedroom 3-Queen ensuite
• Bunkroom2- twin/twin Bunks

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS
• Community seasonally heated pool
• Enclosed playground, yard area \& games
• Gas Grills -- Propane, community use
• Seasonal tram to beach
• Private beach
• Smart TVs in every bedroom? with cable TV
• Fitness Room
• Coffee Maker -- traditional and pod
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath
• Starter kit: toilet paper, paper towels, dishwasher and washing machine pods
• Fully stocked kitchen
• Golf cart charging stations available for a fee through RFV (rental Golf carts)

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- Guests can park in the Redfish Village parking lot.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)

all: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
